title: 이삿짐 업체 견적 받기: 무엇이 포함돼요?
objective: Use -더군요 to share what you saw yourself.
summary: Ask what a moving estimate includes.
setting: At the customer's apartment, a mover has come to give an estimate for a full-service move.

task.title: Use moving-estimate expressions
task.line: Use the words, the dialogue, and -더군요 from page 1 to answer each question.

words.meaning: full-service move (the company packs and unpacks)
words.exampleMeaning: I'm busy this time, so I'm going with a full-service move.

words.meaning: ladder truck (lifts furniture up through a window)
words.example: 골목이 좁으면 사다리차가 못 들어올 수도 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: If the alley is narrow, the ladder truck may not be able to get in.
Is cleaning included in this price too?
Could I get the written estimate by email?
I'll send the deposit to your bank account.

words.meaning: shares something you saw or felt yourself in the past, often with a little surprise. Add it to the stem (좁다 → 좁더군요). Don't use it for your own actions.
words.example: 어제 가 보니까 그 동네는 조용하더군요.
words.exampleMeaning: I went there yesterday, and that neighborhood was quiet.

dialogue.korean: 포장이사로 하면 포장도 다 해 주시는 거죠?
dialogue.meaning: If I go with a full-service move, you do all the packing too, right?

dialogue.korean: 네, 포장부터 정리까지 저희가 다 해 드려요. 이사 가실 집은 몇 층이에요?
dialogue.meaning: Yes, we do everything from packing to unpacking. What floor is your new place on?
The 5th floor. I went there last week, and the elevator was narrow.

dialogue.korean: 그러면 큰 짐은 사다리차로 올려야 할 수도 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: Then we may need to lift the big items up with a ladder truck.

dialogue.korean: 다른 업체는 사다리차 비용이 따로 붙더군요. 여기는 견적에 포함돼요?
dialogue.meaning: At another company, the ladder truck cost was added separately. Is it included in your estimate?

dialogue.korean: 네, 저희는 처음 견적에 다 포함해서 드려요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, we include everything in the first estimate.

exercises: Choose the right word (사다리차 / 계약금 / 견적서): ① 짐이 많고 계단이 좁아서 ____(을/를) 불렀어요. ② 날짜를 예약하려면 ____(을/를) 먼저 내야 해요. ③ 가격을 비교하려고 업체 두 곳에서 ____(을/를) 받았어요.
Rewrite with -더군요 to share what you saw yourself: ① 어제 본 원룸은 생각보다 넓었어요. ② 그 업체 직원들은 아주 친절했어요.
Choose the natural sentence (a or b): (a) 제가 어제 이사 업체에 전화하더군요. (b) 어제 전화해 보니까 그 업체는 일요일에 쉬더군요.
Answer in Korean using the dialogue: ① 사다리차가 왜 필요할 수도 있어요? ② 다른 업체 견적에는 사다리차 비용이 포함됐어요?
answers: ① 사다리차 ② 계약금 ③ 견적서
① 어제 본 원룸은 생각보다 넓더군요. ② 그 업체 직원들은 아주 친절하더군요.
(b) — -더군요 is for what you noticed, not for your own action.
① 이사 갈 집 엘리베이터가 좁아서요. ② 아니요, 사다리차 비용이 따로 붙었어요.
